scope: Vended ContextInjector with cancellation-aware callbacks and ephemeral model-input middleware. Existing memory injection and decision models are outside this increment.

sharedIntegrationRequirements.owner: Root; do not replace the mutable shared project from this manifest.

defaults.name: strands:context-injector
defaults.predicate: Absent; an explicit predicate replaces the built-in trigger.

acceptance: Ephemeral last-user append preserves ordered typed blocks, metadata, tracking identity and durable conversation history.
UserTurn excludes tool-result turns; EveryTurn and custom predicates select the required model calls.
Multiple injectors run in registration order and accumulate an existing dynamic cache suffix.
Shared plugin instances keep agents independent; callbacks see detached messages and borrowed application context without SDK state keys.
Trigger/render exceptions and empty text skip injection; requested caller cancellation wins before model IO and retains its token.

evidence.exclusionReason: Concurrent owners were still implementing automatic telemetry and advanced MCP tasks; those named classes were explicitly excluded from both broad regression commands.
evidence.localFrameworkRuntime: .NET Framework 4.8.1; net48 target, not a clean 4.8 runtime proof
evidence.peerReview: Harness worker bounded read-only PASS; no actionable P1/P2
evidence.formatter: Project-cwd-relative includes positively calibrated by a harmless indentation perturbation in one owned source and one owned test. Apply changed one selected file each; final verify changed 0/709 source and 0/306 test files, with no workspace warnings.

portabilityRegression.cause: Concurrent Root tracing integration converted middleware IValueTaskSource MoveNextAsync to Task using AsTask; the Framework bridge lost the original cancellation token.
portabilityRegression.isolation: Direct callback, injector transform and registry ValueTask await retained OperationCanceledException and exact caller token. Only AsTask conversion changed it to TaskCanceledException with no token.
portabilityRegression.resolution: Root direct-await ValueTask span helper and model/tool tracing call sites, protected by sampled/unsampled native ValueTask-source tests; injector assertions were unchanged.

nativeDifferences: A cancellation-aware renderer constructor plus enum/predicate options expresses the TypeScript configuration union.
Requested caller cancellation propagates instead of being swallowed as an ordinary fail-open callback exception.
limitations: Rendered text is an application-controlled prompt surface; no trust or escaping policy is invented.
Callbacks and Agent/AppState references are borrowed; their own application mutations are not isolated.
Existing memory injection has not been refactored into this primitive.
No generic DecisionModel implementation is claimed by this scope.
